description: The bar chart compares the accuracy of two audio-language models, MMAU and MMAR, across three different datasets: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, while the horizontal axis lists the three datasets. For the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct dataset, MMAU has an accuracy of approximately 50%, while MMAR has about 30%. In the Audio-Reasoner dataset, MMAU shows a higher accuracy of around 60%, compared to MMAR's accuracy of approximately 40%. Lastly, for the Qwen-2.5-Omni dataset, both models exhibit similar performance, with MMAU and MMAR having accuracies close to 60%. The bars are color-coded, with MMAU represented in blue and MMAR in purple. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
